'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**[[Mali War]]
***The [[European Union]] suspends some of its military activities in [[Mali]] due to the alleged involvement of [[Russia]]n [[private military companies]] in the conflict, especially during the [[Siege of Moura]] in March. [https://www.reuters.com/world/eu-ends-part-mali-training-mission-fearing-russian-interference-borrell-says-2022-04-11/ (Reuters)]
**Five soldiers are killed and several others are injured after a [[landmine]] planted by [[Islamic extremism|Islamic extremists]] explodes in Northern [[Pendjari National Park]], [[Benin]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/five-soldiers-killed-attack-northern-benin-park-2022-04-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] calls the Russian war in Ukraine a "[[genocide]]". [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-putin-biden-iowa-europe-97b3a02b61df3012cc5520d4d3b5e806 (AP)]
*[[2022 New York City Subway attack]]
**Seventeen people are injured during a [[mass shooting]] and [[smoke bomb]] attack at the [[36th Street station (BMT Fourth Avenue Line)|36th Street station]] in [[Brooklyn]], [[New York City]], [[United States]]. The attacker is at large. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-61082792 (BBC News)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Israel Police|police]] officer is stabbed and injured by a Palestinian militant in [[Ashkelon]], [[Southern District (Israel)|Southern]] [[Israel]]. The attacker is shot dead. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/apr/12/palestinian-man-shot-dead-after-stabbing-police-officer-in-ashkelon-israel (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Herder–farmer conflicts in Nigeria]]
**Armed [[Fulani herdsmen]] kill 23 people in [[Benue State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.channelstv.com/2022/04/12/23-locals-killed-in-fresh-attacks-on-two-benue-communities/ (Channels TV)]
*[[Western Sahara conflict]]
**[[Algeria]]n authorities accuse [[Morocco]] of attacking an Algerian vehicle convoy on Sunday. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/algeria-says-morocco-attacked-truck-convoys-border-area-2022-04-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Two officers and two [[Tehrik-i-Taliban]] [[militant]]s are killed in an [[ambush]] in [[North Waziristan]], a district of the [[Pakistani province]] of [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]. [https://apnews.com/article/taliban-peshawar-pakistan-395b500fd5c5b03c0f01050941ea7701 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 KwaZulu-Natal floods]]
**Major [[flood]]ing in [[South Africa]], mainly in the city of [[Durban]], kills at least 435 people and leaves many others missing. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-61080056 (BBC News)]

*An explosion at an [[Amal Movement]] [[scout camp]] in [[Sidon]], [[Lebanon]], kills one person and injures seven others. According to the [[Mass media in Lebanon#News agencies|National News Agency]] the incident occurred due to an accident in a [[Hamas]] weapon depot. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/least-one-person-killed-3-injured-explosion-near-lebanons-sidon-security-source-2022-04-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mainland China]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Shanghai]]
*****[[Shanghai]] eases its [[COVID-19]]-related restrictions for some 4.8 million residents amid concerns that [[COVID-19 lockdown|lockdown]] restrictions would harm the [[economy of China|economy]]. '''International relations'''
*[[Cameroon–Russia relations]]
**''[[Jeune Afrique]]'' reveals that the [[Defence minister|defence ministers]] of [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russia]] and [[Ministry of Defence (Cameroon)|Cameroon]] sign a new military cooperation agreement, renewing a similar agreement signed in 2015. [https://www.jeuneafrique.com/1340317/politique/cameroun-russie-vers-un-rapprochement-militaire-entre-yaounde-et-moscou/ (''Jeune Afrique'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
**[[Partygate]]
***[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]], his wife [[Carrie Johnson]], and [[Chancellor of the Exchequer|Chancellor]] [[Rishi Sunak]] are fined for [[Partygate|breaching]] the [[COVID-19 lockdown in the United Kingdom|COVID-19 lockdown rules]] in [[United Kingdom|the country]]. [https://theguardian.com/politics/2022/apr/12/boris-johnson-and-rishi-sunak-fined-for-breaking-covid-lockdown-laws (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Abortion in the United States]]
**[[Abortion in Oklahoma]]
***[[Governor of Oklahoma|Oklahoma Governor]] [[Kevin Stitt]] signs a law criminalising [[abortion]] in the state, with the exception of cases when the mother's health is in danger. According to the law, anyone performing an abortion could face a fine of up to $100,000 and up to 10 years in prison, although the woman undergoing the abortion would not be penalised. [https://apnews.com/article/abortion-oklahoma-law-87880e9f3c7bde2ae634cb2f02839e6e (AP)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2022/04/12/abortion-oklahoma-criminal/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Russian fake news laws]]
**A [[Colombians|Colombian]] citizen is arrested in [[Russia]] on charges of "spreading false information" about the [[Russian Armed Forces]] on [[social media]]. This is the first known case of a foreign national facing possible prosecution under Russia's new "fake news" law. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2022/04/12/colombian-faces-10-years-in-jail-for-ukraine-war-fakes-a77320 (''The Moscow Times'')] 
*[[Constitutional Convention (Chile)|Chilean Constitutional Convention]]
**The [[Chile]]an Constitutional Convention approves defining the country as a "[[Welfare state|Social State]]" in the new fundamental law, a fact that various constituents and experts interpret as a turning point in the [[history of Chile|country's history]]. [https://www.eldiario.es/politica/chile-define-social-derecho-nueva-constitucion_1_8909398.html (''eldiario.es'')]
*[[Law of Indonesia]]
**[[Law on Elimination of Sexual Violence]]
***[[People's Consultative Assembly|Indonesia's parliament]] passed a bill outlawing [[sexual abuse]] and [[forced marriage]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/04/12/asia/indonesia-sexual-violence-bill-abuse-forced-marriage-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
